name: Technology & Research
summary: The research system implementation is largely faithful to the design specifications. Core RP calculations, miniaturization formulas, and tech tier costs match the design documents. However, several gaps exist: the code lacks implementation for bio weapons, some special weapon mechanics (percent-damage weapons use different rates than design), and cloning is implemented differently than design (flat bonus vs BC-invested). The combat system implements most weapon special effects but has some formula deviations. UI correctly displays research allocation and field targeting.

matches.description: Research building multipliers match design §2: Research Lab +0.5, Supercomputer +1.0, Autolab +1.5, Galactic Cybernet +2.0 (cumulative)
Racial research modifiers match design §3: Rats 1.50, Mice 1.15, Rabbits 0.90, Ants 0.90, Guinea Pigs 0.80, others 1.00
Planet RP formula correctly applies racial modifier to RP generation (not tech cost) per design §7 clarification
Difficulty modifier only affects AI tech cost, not player RP generation, per design §7
Galaxy size modifiers match design: small 0.75, medium 1.00, large 1.25, huge 1.50
Miniaturization formula matches design §9: 5% reduction per tier, 50% maximum cap
Research allocation correctly enforces 100% sum constraint per design §5
Tech tier cost table is loaded from JSON and matches design §6 values (50 to 100,000 RP)
Research overflow correctly carries to next tech per design §8
Black Hole Generator mechanics implemented: 1d4 roll × 25% base destruction, 2% penalty per shield class, 3-turn cooldown
Displacement Device 33% hit avoidance chance implemented correctly
Warp Dissipator prevents enemy retreat as specified in design
WeaponEffect interface supports design weapon properties: damageMin/Max, attacksPerRound, missileSpeed, mirvCount, damagePerMirv, groundCombatBonus, ignoresShields, etc.
ComputerEffect interface supports design properties: attackRating, missileDefense, factoriesPerPop, initiativeBonus, colonyDetectRange, shipDetectRange, seeCloaked
ArmorEffect interface supports hpMultiplier and groundCombatBonus per design
ShieldEffect interface supports damageAbsorption, defenseBonus, invisibleUntilFire per design

mismatches.design_spec: Ion Stream Projector: 'Deals 20% of target's current HP as damage'
mismatches.actual_impl: Uses weapon.percentDamage which could be any value; not specifically validated to be 0.20 for Ion Stream Projector
mismatches.recommendation: Ensure components.json defines Ion Stream Projector with percentDamage: 0.20 and Neutron Stream Projector with percentDamage: 0.40

mismatches.design_spec: §4 Artifacts World: 'ongoing +25% RP from that planet' via multiplier 1.25
mismatches.actual_impl: Code uses technologiesData.special_rp_bonuses.artifacts_world_multiplier but design clarification (M2) states 1.25 while earlier text says 2.0. Verify JSON value matches intended 1.25.
mismatches.recommendation: Confirm technologies.json special_rp_bonuses.artifacts_world_multiplier is 1.25 (not 2.0). The design doc has conflicting values in different sections.

mismatches.design_spec: Zyro Shield: '75% chance to destroy incoming missiles − 1% per missile tech level'
mismatches.actual_impl: calculateInterceptionChance sums beam weapon PD (10% per attack) and anti-missile rockets (40% - techLevel), but does not implement Zyro Shield's 75% base - 1%/TL formula
mismatches.recommendation: Add Zyro Shield interception check: ships with zyroShield property should get 75% - (missileTechLevel * 1)% destruction chance per missile

mismatches.design_spec: Lightning Shield: '100% chance to destroy incoming missiles − 1% per missile tech level'
mismatches.actual_impl: Lightning Shield missile interception not implemented in calculateInterceptionChance
mismatches.recommendation: Add Lightning Shield check: 100% - (missileTechLevel * 1)% destruction chance per missile

mismatches.design_spec: Energy Pulsar: '5 damage to all adjacent ships + 1 damage per 2 firing ships'
mismatches.actual_impl: Energy Pulsar weapon special effect not implemented in combat.ts
mismatches.recommendation: Implement Energy Pulsar AoE damage: 5 base damage to all ships in adjacent hexes, +1 per 2 ships with the weapon in the stack, affects friendly ships too

mismatches.design_spec: Ionic Pulsar: '10 damage to all adjacent ships + 1 damage per 2 firing ships'
mismatches.actual_impl: Ionic Pulsar weapon special effect not implemented
mismatches.recommendation: Implement Ionic Pulsar as upgraded Energy Pulsar with 10 base damage

mismatches.design_spec: Stasis Field: 'Ship cannot move, fire, or retreat' (prevents retreat explicitly)
mismatches.actual_impl: Stasis Field effect not implemented in combat.ts; the design clarifies stasis prevents retreat contrary to an earlier note
mismatches.recommendation: Implement Stasis Field: target ship cannot act (move/fire/retreat) for 1 combat round, immune to targeting while in stasis, cannot use on same target consecutive rounds

mismatches.design_spec: Repulsor Beam: 'Push enemy ships 2 hexes away'
mismatches.actual_impl: Repulsor Beam push effect not implemented
mismatches.recommendation: Implement Repulsor Beam: auto-activates when enemy enters range 2, pushes them 2 hexes back

mismatches.design_spec: Cloaking Device: '+5 Defense, invisible until firing'
mismatches.actual_impl: Cloaking reduces hit chance by 50% (-5 defense levels = -50%) but design says +5 defense (should be -25% at ×5 per level formula)
mismatches.recommendation: Fix cloaking hit penalty: +5 defense at ×5% per level = -25% hit chance, not -50%

mismatches.design_spec: Anti-Missile Rockets: 'Point defense — destroys 40% of incoming missiles (−1% per missile tech level)'
mismatches.actual_impl: Code subtracts missileTechLevel directly: 'Math.max(0, 40 - missileTechLevel)' instead of '40 - missileTechLevel%'
mismatches.recommendation: Formula should be: 40 - (missileTechLevel * 1) = 40 - techLevel percentage points, which is what the code does. This is correct but verify missiles have proper techLevel values.

mismatches.design_spec: §6 Force Fields tier costs use accelerated schedule (e.g., FF Tier 14 = 50,000 RP = Global Tier 18)
mismatches.actual_impl: getTechCost uses single TIER_COST_MAP lookup; does not distinguish Force Fields accelerated cost schedule
mismatches.recommendation: Either: (a) store Force Fields techs with their effective global tier in JSON, or (b) add field parameter to getTechCost to apply FF-specific tier mapping

mismatches.design_spec: Scatter Packs: 'MIRV missiles that split into multiple warheads' (e.g., Scatter Pack V = 5 MIRVs × 6 dmg each)
mismatches.actual_impl: WeaponEffect has mirvCount and damagePerMirv properties defined, but combat.ts does not handle MIRV splitting logic
mismatches.recommendation: Implement MIRV handling in combat: when missile hits, spawn mirvCount warheads each dealing damagePerMirv damage

mismatches.actual_impl: calcHitChanceVs uses: 50 + differential * 5 where differential = attackRating - defenseRating. This is (AR - DR) × 5%, not AR × 5% - DR × 3%
mismatches.recommendation: Minor formula difference: design uses separate multipliers (×5% attack, ×3% defense) but code uses unified differential (×5%). Consider which is intended; current implementation slightly favors attackers.

Technology Nullifier: Target -2 to -6 attack rating (Tech Level 49)
Hyperspace Communications: Reroute fleets in transit (Tech Level 34)

Advanced Damage Control: +30% HP per turn combat repair
Hull Space bonuses: Improved/Advanced/Superior/Maximum Hull Space (+20%/+40%/+60%/+80%)
Tech Stealing (Espionage): Steal_Success_Chance formula with Tech_Difficulty modifier

not_in_design.feature: researchMultiplier planet property that can be set to any value (design specifies only 1.0, 1.25, 4.0 for standard/artifacts/Orion)
Experience accuracy bonus (-5%/0%/+5%/+10% for rookie/regular/veteran/elite) - not found in technology design docs (may be in ships/combat-algorithm.md)
Range modifiers for hit chance (Point Blank +10%, Close +0%, Medium -5%, Long -10%, Very Long -20%) - may be documented elsewhere
Size modifier for hit chance: (target_size_class - 1) × 5% - may be documented in combat-algorithm.md
miniaturization_minimum_scale constant (code references it from JSON) - design only mentions 50% max reduction, not explicit minimum scale factor
